dataVintage: 2015–2025 tourism; 2017–2024 full STI; sentiment through 2026 Q3

provenance.mode: Final v5 notebook exports; equal-pillar STI with PCA used as a robustness comparison.

caveats: Missing observations are null, never zero or interpolated. Environmental coverage varies by indicator.
The equal-pillar STI covers 13 monitored states in 2017–2024; Perlis, W.P. Kuala Lumpur and W.P. Putrajaya receive only the labelled Economic+Social fallback where available.
Only the domestic-visitor model beats its naive baseline; 2025 environmental actuals are not yet published.
The final causal model uses 91 observations from final_df with state/year fixed effects and HC1 standard errors; it estimates association, not definitive causation.
State TSA visitor figures and the master panel use slightly different published precision. National totals are shown separately.
